name: Casa Bleu -A Timeless Royal Escape by Artive Stays
hostAbout:
Founded by Nishant, Vaibhav and Parull, Artive Stays is a curated collection of concept-led homes shaped by exceptional design and meaningful hospitality.

Every property is exclusively custom-designed by co-founder and interior designer Parull Saini, creating spaces with a distinct identity, character and atmosphere.

Each stay is conceived as an experience—immersive, memorable and unlike anywhere else.

We look forward to welcoming you into a space designed to be felt, not just stayed in.

description: Casa Bleu -A timeless luxury 2BHK featuring unique concept w/ a pool table, 65-inch smart TV, and an elegant bathtub, Casa Bleu is inspired by the seamless fusion of Italian modern-classical elegance and Jaipur’s iconic blue pottery art. Centrally located in Jaipur, Casa Bleu offers a design-led stay where artistry and comfort come together seamlessly.
